title: Number line ١ to ١٠ and unit check sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Special days, summer and numbers
source: Written for arabic/y3 lesson 7 (Number line ١ to ١٠ and unit check sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 7: Numbers 1 to 10, read and written; unit check. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

head: Not this
This
rows: ٦ is six (sittah); ٧ is seven (sab'ah): ٧ looks like a V

blocks.text: Write the Arabic word for each number under its digit.

keywords.def: review, going over what we learnt

questions.q: Read: ٣ + ٢ = ٥ and say it in Arabic.
questions.a: ثَلَاثَة + اِثْنَان = خَمْسَة (thalathah wa ithnan: khamsah)

questions.q: Core (unit check, portal response box or paper): 1) Write ١ to ١٠ in order. 2) Match: الصَّيْفُ / شَمْسٌ / يَوْمُ الجُمُعَةِ with summer / sun / Friday.
questions.a: 1) ١ ٢ ٣ ٤ ٥ ٦ ٧ ٨ ٩ ١٠ 2) الصَّيْفُ summer; شَمْسٌ sun; يَوْمُ الجُمُعَةِ Friday

questions.q: Extend: Write the sums in Arabic digits: 4 + 4 = 8; 6 + 3 = 9.
Stretch: Write الجَوُّ حَارٌّ and عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ and say when you would say each.
questions.a: On a hot day; on Eid.
B) ٥. ٥ is five; ٤ is four and ٦ is six.

questions.q: Which is ten? A) ١٠ B) ٧ C) ٦
Big question: how do Arabic numbers look and sound? Write ٥ and say it.
